description: Everything known about a single URL in one read: GSC queries/clicks for that page, sessions and engagement, AI crawler fetches, AI referral clicks, the latest index verdict, open audit findings and real-user CWV. Paid plans read GSC live for that page (queries and average position); otherwise the archived page snapshot is returned with search.source=archive and empty queries. The join is per page, so numbers are not duplicated across queries. Each block carries its own na/reason — a missing source is not a zero. Read-only. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_page_report
title: One page across every source
